subject: PICTURE clause
notes: kb/Work PB569 LANDED. SR7 is decided from the characters PICMODE delimited: after PIC_STRING's single trailing-separator trim, a character-string whose last symbol is ',' or '.' shall be followed immediately by the separator period (PictureSeparatorPeriodRule, every PICTURE parent, once per clause); otherwise COBOL2419 at all four editions. Both arms: PIC 999,, USAGE DISPLAY. and PIC 999,; VALUE ZERO. (the ',' arm the refutation measured) AND PIC 999., VALUE ZERO. / PIC 999.; VALUE ZERO. (the '.' arm, which the refutation called structural and which compiled silently as [000.]). The legal shapes bind: PIC 999,. -> [012,], USAGE DISPLAY PIC 999,. -> [005,] (PICTURE last after another clause), PIC 999.. -> [012.], and PIC 999, VALUE ZERO. is character-string 999 + a separator comma (8.3.5 rule 2) -> [000].
